notes.title: Social DLC / UP-DATE # 4!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26878642/4ba180a0f417a95ef3adf8775407a59615560915.png[/img]

[i]“One of the greatest gifts you can give to anyone is the gift of attention”[/i] [b]- Jim Rohn[/b]

Guys, of behalf of Green Lava Studios, we will always be grateful with y’all. Tomorrow (May 29th), the team will deliver a new game: Birdcakes. This wouldn't be even remotely possible without all of you. Thank you for supporting our work!

Alright people! Let’s do this!

The team made a new update to celebrate Birdcakes’ launch! How? Well... they crafted a weird cupcake girl... and I’m not sure how to feel about her to be honest, it’s an anime thing I guess. But hey! You can totally check her out! She is kinda sweet!

Meet Cake-chan and discover her passions!  

I hope y’all like it!!


[h1]About Social DLC:[/h1]
We will keep making new dates (or mini games) for free, as long as we can, just share #MrMassagy to your people! 

“Aww man!! These guys are making more dates!”- I hear you say! Well yeah, that’s the whole idea of this. I think they have some more dates planned so stay tuned!

Peace!
Sean Callaghan
PR Manager or summin’...

notes.title: Social DLC / UP-DATE # 3!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26878642/55dbbaab491d97b40031966d615ce08d6bf2faed.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 

Well, this has been a long time coming, but it’s finally here. The date-crazed, egomaniacal, super smart OS lady S.O.N.I.A is ready to be courted (whether Johnny wants to or not), on this beautiful Valentine’s morning.

Along with S.O.N.I.A., comes the coveted, proper ending of the game, two more achievements, and one more Item for Johnny’s room. We hope Steam users can finally enjoy her sweet, robotic smooth-talking. 

[h1]About Social DLC:[/h1]
We will keep making new dates (or mini games) for free, as long as we can, just share #MrMassagy to your people! 

“But why is it taking so long, guys?!”- I hear you say! Well, it's a tiny team working on more than 3 games at a time. But I know they have the drive to invite a few more dates this year!

Cheers,
Sean Callaghan 


PS: You might need to get 3 stars with all the dates to unlock S.O.N.I.A.

notes.title: Social DLC / UP-DATE # 2!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26878642/8b6048395b50e8d1f4aad1e5c4ae3238319f3620.png[/img]


Hello everyone!

To celebrate Valentine this week, we decided to make a fun li’l update! The team noticed that Nicole has some fans, so they did a mini game for her! YAY! (yep, we read comments about the game everyday... like... always... Thank you for that!)

Enjoy Kill Duck! A tribute to Nicole and... some old game I dunno... Help her get those delicious ducks and make herself feel wild! And if you manage to kill 100 ducks, you might win a prize!! This mini game also has two new achievements and a Leaderboard!! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26878642/d79ca2dc16996383af3ced4692ffbfebba5708bf.png[/img]

This up-date doesn’t have a new date, but who knows?! Maybe next month a new date will finally throw (her?)self in the muddy, dangerous waters of Linger, so keep an eye out!

But wait! There’s more: Our programmer decided to drink some extra cappuccinos this month and he finally fixed the [b]screenshot issue[/b]! You can now take screenshots with F12!! "[i] Massagy X3[/i]"!! 

We hope you enjoy this Up-date #2. The team is always listening to your feedback to make this game as great as it can get.

[h1] About Social DLC:[/h1]
We will keep making new dates (or mini games) for free, as long as we can, just share #MrMassagy to your people!

notes.title: Social DLC / UP-DATE # 1!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26878642/5c89156f2aabd66a27816a010887022e658df41f.png[/img]

Hello everyone! To celebrate a new year, a new life, and a new Massagy wife, we’re proud to announce the first of the free Social DLC Dates for Mr. Massagy: the adorable Navia!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26878642/18be67e5bf70c4b9d17aef49e301b320528308be.png[/img]
 
Along with Navia, two more Steam achievements and a new feature called the [b]“Pile of Things”[/b] are waiting to be discovered! Be sure to look for the “Things” from inside the dates! (One thing per date, they are somewhere between conversations...) [b]UP-DATE Mr. Massagy Now![/b]
 
PS: I’d talk about Samba to Rial if I were you.([i]SambaAA BAM BAM sam sam sambarium![/i])

[h1]About Social DLC:[/h1] We will keep making new dates for free, as long as we can, just share #MrMassagy to your people!
